```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

# ── Constants (must match your R pricing script) ──────────────────────────────
MAGIC_NUMBER_PRESEASON <- 10490
BASEMENT_PRICE        <- 230000
PRICING_CHANGE_COMMON_FACTOR <- 0.25
SCORE_HISTORY_COUNT_CAP <- 5L
ROUNDING_PRECISION    <- -3   # thousands

# ── Pricing parameters table (weights) ───────────────────────────────────────
pricing_parameters <- tibble(score_count = SCORE_HISTORY_COUNT_CAP:1L) |>
  mutate(
    weight  = score_count / sum(score_count),
    weights = map(score_count, ~head(weight, n = .x)),
    price_change_factor = PRICING_CHANGE_COMMON_FACTOR * map_dbl(weights, sum),
    weights_breakeven   = map(weights, tail, n = -1),
    breakeven_factor    = map_dbl(weights_breakeven, sum) / head(weight, 1)
  )

# ── 2026 bye schedule (rounds teams have byes) ────────────────────────────────
bye_schedule <- list(
  "Round 0"  = c("ESS","PTA","RIC","ADE","FRE","MEL","WCE","NTH"),
  "Round 2"  = c("CAR","COL","BRL","GEE"),
  "Round 3"  = c("HAW","GCS","WBD","SYD"),
  "Round 4"  = c("STK","GWS")
)

# Invert: team -> bye round number
team_bye <- list()
for (rnd_name in names(bye_schedule)) {
  rnd_num <- as.integer(gsub("Round ", "", rnd_name))
  for (team in bye_schedule[[rnd_name]]) {
    team_bye[[team]] <- rnd_num
  }
}

# ── Load player data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
players_raw <- data.table::fread("https://github.com/bit-in-that/data-automation/raw/main/2026/output/afl_fantasy_breakevens.csv")

# ── Magic number (use pre-season as fallback) ─────────────────────────────────
magic_number <- tryCatch({
  # Try to derive from player data
  if (!is.null(players_raw) && "r0_score" %in% names(players_raw)) {
    played <- players_raw |> filter(!is.na(r0_score))
    if (nrow(played) > 0) {
      sum(played$hidden_price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(played$r0_score, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      MAGIC_NUMBER_PRESEASON
    }
  } else {
    MAGIC_NUMBER_PRESEASON
  }
}, error = function(e) MAGIC_NUMBER_PRESEASON)

# ── Build player lookup JSON ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!is.null(players_raw)) {
  players_json <- players_raw |>
    transmute(
      id           = id,
      name         = player_name,
      team         = if ("team" %in% names(players_raw)) team else "UNK",
      position     = position,
      price        = if ("hidden_price" %in% names(players_raw)) hidden_price else starting_price,
      starting_price = starting_price,
      r0_score     = r0_score,
      breakeven    = breakeven
    ) |>
    arrange(name) |>
    toJSON(na = "null") |> as.character()
} else {
  players_json <- "[]"
}

magic_json    <- as.character(toJSON(magic_number, auto_unbox = TRUE))
bye_json      <- as.character(toJSON(team_bye,     auto_unbox = TRUE))
params_json   <- as.character(pricing_parameters |>
  transmute(
    score_count         = score_count,
    price_change_factor = price_change_factor,
    weights             = weights,
    weights_breakeven   = weights_breakeven
  ) |>
  toJSON())
basement_json <- as.character(toJSON(BASEMENT_PRICE, auto_unbox = TRUE))
```

#| output: asis
#| echo: false
cat(paste0(
  '<script>\n',
  '  const PLAYERS_DATA      = ', players_json, ';\n',
  '  const MAGIC_NUMBER      = ', magic_json, ';\n',
  '  const BYE_SCHEDULE      = ', bye_json, ';\n',
  '  const PRICING_PARAMS    = ', params_json, ';\n',
  '  const BASEMENT_PRICE_JS = ', basement_json, ';\n',
  '</script>\n'
))

<!-- JavaScript engine                                                        -->
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ── Parse data passed from R ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const players        = PLAYERS_DATA;
  let   magicNumber    = parseFloat(MAGIC_NUMBER);
  const byeSchedule   = BYE_SCHEDULE;  
  const pricingParams  = PRICING_PARAMS;
  const BASEMENT       = parseInt(BASEMENT_PRICE_JS);
  const NUM_ROUNDS     = 6;   // R1 through R6
  const MAGIC_BY_ROUND = { 0: 10490, 1: 10180, 2: 10104, 3: 10054, 4: 9984, 5: 9988, 6: 10072 };

  // ── DOM refs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const searchInput   = document.getElementById("playerSearch");
  const acList        = document.getElementById("autocompleteList");
  const infoCard      = document.getElementById("playerInfoCard");
  const roundsGrid    = document.getElementById("roundsGrid");
  const resultsSection= document.getElementById("resultsSection");
  const resultsHead   = document.getElementById("resultsHead");
  const resultsBody   = document.getElementById("resultsBody");
  const mnInput       = document.getElementById("magicNumberInput");

  // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let selectedPlayer = null;

  // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fmt  = v => "$" + Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-AU");
  const fmtD = v => {
    const r = Math.round(v);
    if (r > 0) return `<span class="pos-change">+${r.toLocaleString("en-AU")}</span>`;
    if (r < 0) return `<span class="neg-change">${r.toLocaleString("en-AU")}</span>`;
    return `<span class="zero-change">$0</span>`;
  };

  // ── Pricing core (mirrors R logic) ───────────────────────────────────────
  function getParams(scoreCount) {
    return pricingParams.find(p => p.score_count === scoreCount);
  }

  function weightedMean(values, weights) {
    let s = 0, w = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) { s += values[i] * weights[i]; w += weights[i]; }
    return s / w;
  }

  /**
   * Calculate price change for a player given their score history and current price.
   * scores: array of scores in chronological order (oldest first), most recent last.
   * Returns { priceChange, newPrice, weightedAvg, breakeven }
   */
  function calcPriceChange(scores, price, mn) {
    // Take up to last 5, reverse so most-recent is first
    const sc    = scores.filter(s => s !== null && s !== undefined).slice(-5).reverse();
    const count = sc.length;
    if (count === 0) return null;

    const params = getParams(count);
    if (!params) return null;

    const wts = Array.isArray(params.weights[0]) 
      ? params.weights[0] 
      : Array.isArray(params.weights) 
        ? params.weights 
        : [];
    const factor       = params.price_change_factor;
    console.log("calcPriceChange - sc:", sc, "wts:", wts, "factor:", factor, "price:", price, "mn:", mn);
    const prevPricedAt = price / mn;
    const wa           = weightedMean(sc, wts);
    const priceChangeRaw = mn * factor * (wa - prevPricedAt);

    let newPriceRaw;
    if (price + priceChangeRaw <= BASEMENT) {
      newPriceRaw = BASEMENT;
    } else {
      newPriceRaw = Math.max(price + priceChangeRaw, BASEMENT);
    }

    // Round to nearest 1000
    const newPriceRounded    = Math.round(newPriceRaw / 1000) * 1000;
    const priceChangeRounded = newPriceRounded - price;

    return {
      priceChangeRaw,
      priceChange: priceChangeRounded,
      newPrice:    newPriceRounded,
      weightedAvg: wa
    };
  }

  /**
   * Calculate breakeven: score needed next game to maintain price.
   * scores: history array (same convention as calcPriceChange — chronological, most-recent last).
   */
  function calcBreakeven(scores, price, mn, priceTarget) {
    if (priceTarget === undefined) priceTarget = price;
    const sc    = scores.filter(s => s !== null && s !== undefined).slice(-4).reverse(); // last 4
    const count = sc.length;
    const params = getParams(Math.min(count + 1, 5));
    console.log("count:", count, "params:", params);
    if (!params) return null;

    const firstWeight = params.weights[0];
    const wtsBreakeven = params.weights_breakeven || [];
    console.log("calcBreakeven - sc:", sc, "wtsBreakeven:", wtsBreakeven, "firstWeight:", firstWeight, "count:", count);
    console.log("BE inputs:", {sc, wtsBreakeven, firstWeight, price, mn, count});
    console.log("BE wtsBreakeven type:", typeof wtsBreakeven, Array.isArray(wtsBreakeven), wtsBreakeven);
    console.log("BE firstWeight type:", typeof firstWeight, firstWeight);
    console.log("BE pricedAt:", price / mn, "isNaN:", isNaN(price / mn));
    const totalWeights  = (wtsBreakeven.length > 0 ? wtsBreakeven.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0) : 0) + firstWeight;
    const pricedAt      = price / mn;
    const pricedAtTarget= priceTarget / mn;
    const diffTerm      = (pricedAtTarget - pricedAt) / 0.25;

    let weightedSumPrev = 0;
    if (sc.length > 0 && wtsBreakeven.length > 0) {
      weightedSumPrev = weightedMean(sc, wtsBreakeven) * wtsBreakeven.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
    }

    const beRaw = (diffTerm + totalWeights * pricedAt - weightedSumPrev) / firstWeight;
    return Math.ceil(beRaw);
  }

  // ── Build the rounds grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function buildRoundsGrid(byeRound) {
    roundsGrid.innerHTML = "";
    for (let r = 1; r <= NUM_ROUNDS; r++) {
      const isBye = byeRound && r === byeRound;
      const cell  = document.createElement("div");
      cell.className = "round-cell" + (isBye ? " bye-round" : "");
      cell.dataset.round = r;

      const lbl = document.createElement("label");
      lbl.htmlFor = `score_r${r}`;
      lbl.textContent = `Round ${r}`;
      cell.appendChild(lbl);

      if (isBye) {
        const badge = document.createElement("span");
        badge.className = "bye-badge";
        badge.textContent = "BYE";
        cell.appendChild(badge);
        const inp = document.createElement("input");
        inp.type = "text"; inp.value = "BYE"; inp.disabled = true;
        inp.id = `score_r${r}`;
        cell.appendChild(inp);
      } else {
        const inp = document.createElement("input");
        inp.type = "number"; inp.min = 0; inp.max = 250;
        inp.placeholder = "Score…";
        inp.id = `score_r${r}`;
        inp.addEventListener("input", recalculate);
        cell.appendChild(inp);
      }
      roundsGrid.appendChild(cell);
    }
  }

  // ── Populate info card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function populateInfoCard(p) {
    document.getElementById("infoName").textContent      = p.name;
    document.getElementById("infoTeam").textContent      = p.team || "—";
    document.getElementById("infoPosition").textContent  = p.position || "—";
    document.getElementById("infoPrice").textContent = p.starting_price ? fmt(p.starting_price) : "—";
    document.getElementById("infoPricedAt").textContent = p.starting_price ? Math.round(p.starting_price / 10490) : "—";
    const r0Bye = byeSchedule[p.team] === 0;
    document.getElementById("infoR0Score").textContent = p.r0_score != null ? p.r0_score : (r0Bye ? "BYE" : "DNP");
    document.getElementById("infoBreakeven").textContent = p.breakeven != null ? Math.round(p.breakeven) : "—";
    const byeRound = byeSchedule[p.team];
    document.getElementById("infoBye").textContent       = byeRound ? `Round ${byeRound}` : "—";
    infoCard.classList.add("visible");
  }

  // ── Main calculation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function recalculate() {
    if (!selectedPlayer) return;

    const mn = (r) => MAGIC_BY_ROUND[r] ?? magicNumber;
    const byeRound  = byeSchedule[selectedPlayer.team] || null;
    const startPrice= selectedPlayer.price;
    const r0Score   = selectedPlayer.r0_score;

    const enteredScores = [];
    for (let r = 1; r <= NUM_ROUNDS; r++) {
      if (byeRound && r === byeRound) {
        enteredScores.push(null);
      } else {
        const v = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`score_r${r}`)?.value);
        enteredScores.push(isNaN(v) ? null : v);
      }
    }

    const baseHistory = r0Score != null ? [r0Score] : [];

    const rows = {
      scores:      [],
      priceChange: [],
      totalChange: [],
      price:       [],
      pricedAt:    [],
      breakeven:   []
    };

    let currentPrice = startPrice;
    let history      = [...baseHistory];

    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_ROUNDS; i++) {
      const roundNum  = i + 1;
      const isBye     = byeRound && roundNum === byeRound;
      const score     = enteredScores[i];
      const mnNow     = mn(roundNum);
      const mnNext    = mn(Math.min(roundNum + 1, 6));

      if (isBye) {
        rows.scores.push("BYE");
        rows.priceChange.push(null);
        rows.totalChange.push(null);
        rows.price.push(currentPrice);
        rows.pricedAt.push(Math.round(currentPrice / mnNow));
        const be = calcBreakeven(history, currentPrice, mnNext);
        rows.breakeven.push(be);
        continue;
      }

      if (score === null) {
        rows.scores.push("—");
        rows.priceChange.push(null);
        rows.totalChange.push(null);
        rows.price.push(currentPrice);
        rows.pricedAt.push(Math.round(currentPrice / mnNow));
        const be = calcBreakeven(history, currentPrice, mnNext);
        rows.breakeven.push(be);
        continue;
      }

      const newHistory = [...history, score];
      const result     = calcPriceChange(newHistory, currentPrice, mnNow);

      if (!result) {
        rows.scores.push(score);
        rows.priceChange.push(null);
        rows.totalChange.push(null);
        rows.price.push(currentPrice);
        rows.pricedAt.push(Math.round(currentPrice / mnNow));
        rows.breakeven.push(null);
        continue;
      }

      const newPrice    = result.newPrice;
      const change      = result.priceChange;
      const totalChange = newPrice - selectedPlayer.starting_price;

      rows.scores.push(score);
      rows.priceChange.push(change);
      rows.totalChange.push(totalChange);
      rows.price.push(newPrice);
      rows.pricedAt.push(Math.round(newPrice / mnNow));

      const be = calcBreakeven(newHistory, newPrice, mnNext);
      rows.breakeven.push(be);

      currentPrice = newPrice;
      history      = newHistory;
    }

    renderTable(rows, byeRound);
    resultsSection.classList.add("visible");
  }

  // ── Render results table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderTable(rows, byeRound) {
    const container = document.getElementById("resultsTableContainer");
    container.innerHTML = '<table class="results-table"><thead id="resultsHead"></thead><tbody id="resultsBody"></tbody></table>';
    const resultsHead = container.querySelector("thead");
    const resultsBody = container.querySelector("tbody");

    // Header
    let hHtml = "<tr><th>Stat</th>";
    hHtml += `<th>Round 0</th>`;
    for (let r = 1; r <= NUM_ROUNDS; r++) {
      hHtml += `<th>Round ${r}</th>`;
    }
    hHtml += "</tr>";
    resultsHead.innerHTML = hHtml;

    const rowDefs = [
      { key: "scores",      label: "Score" },
      { key: "priceChange", label: "Price Change",  money: true, diff: true },
      { key: "totalChange", label: "Total Change",  money: true, diff: true },
      { key: "price",       label: "Price",         money: true },
      { key: "pricedAt",    label: "Priced At" },
      { key: "breakeven",   label: "New Breakeven" }
    ];

    let bHtml = "";
    for (const rd of rowDefs) {
      bHtml += `<tr><td>${rd.label}</td>`;
      // Round 0 column
      if (rd.key === "scores") {
        const r0Bye = byeSchedule[selectedPlayer.team] === 0;
bHtml += `<td>${selectedPlayer.r0_score != null ? selectedPlayer.r0_score : (r0Bye ? "BYE" : "DNP")}</td>`;
      } else if (rd.key === "price") {
        bHtml += `<td>${fmt(selectedPlayer.price)}</td>`;
      } else if (rd.key === "pricedAt") {
        bHtml += `<td>${Math.round(selectedPlayer.price / MAGIC_BY_ROUND[0])}</td>`;
      } else if (rd.key === "breakeven") {
        bHtml += `<td>${selectedPlayer.breakeven != null ? Math.round(selectedPlayer.breakeven) : "—"}</td>`;
      } else if (rd.key === "priceChange") {
        const r0change = selectedPlayer.price - selectedPlayer.starting_price;
        bHtml += `<td>${fmtD(r0change)}</td>`;
      } else if (rd.key === "totalChange") {
        const r0change = selectedPlayer.price - selectedPlayer.starting_price;
        bHtml += `<td>${fmtD(r0change)}</td>`;
      } else {
        bHtml += `<td>—</td>`;
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < NUM_ROUNDS; i++) {
        const r   = i + 1;
        const val = rows[rd.key][i];
        const bye = byeRound && r === byeRound;

        let cell;
        if (val === null || val === undefined) {
          cell = `<td class="${bye ? "bye-col" : ""}">—</td>`;
        } else if (val === "BYE") {
          cell = `<td class="bye-col">BYE</td>`;
        } else if (val === "—") {
          cell = `<td>—</td>`;
        } else if (rd.diff && rd.money) {
          cell = `<td>${fmtD(val)}</td>`;
        } else if (rd.money) {
          cell = `<td>${fmt(val)}</td>`;
        } else {
          cell = `<td>${val}</td>`;
        }
        bHtml += cell;
      }
      bHtml += "</tr>";
    }
    resultsBody.innerHTML = bHtml;
  }

  // ── Autocomplete ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let acIndex = -1;

  searchInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const q = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    acList.innerHTML = "";
    acIndex = -1;
    if (q.length < 2) return;

    const matches = players
      .filter(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      .slice(0, 20);

    matches.forEach((p, i) => {
      const div = document.createElement("div");
      div.textContent = `${p.name} (${p.team || "?"})`;
      div.dataset.idx = i;
      div.addEventListener("mousedown", () => selectPlayer(p));
      acList.appendChild(div);
    });
  });

  searchInput.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    const items = acList.querySelectorAll("div");
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { acIndex = Math.min(acIndex + 1, items.length - 1); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { acIndex = Math.max(acIndex - 1, 0); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter" && acIndex >= 0) {
      items[acIndex].dispatchEvent(new Event("mousedown"));
      return;
    } else return;
    items.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle("active", i === acIndex));
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", e => {
    if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !acList.contains(e.target)) {
      acList.innerHTML = "";
    }
  });

  function selectPlayer(p) {
    selectedPlayer = p;
    searchInput.value = p.name;
    acList.innerHTML = "";
    populateInfoCard(p);
    const byeRound = byeSchedule[p.team] || null;
    buildRoundsGrid(byeRound);
    resultsSection.classList.remove("visible");
    recalculate();
  }

})();
</script>
```
